> INS Overseas is a manufacturer and wholesale exporter of handmade leather journals, cotton rag paper, seed paper, and artisan gift products. Founded in 1995 in Sanganer, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. A four-generation family craft business exporting to 40+ countries worldwide. Minimum orders start from __MOQ:lowest__ units and vary by product. Custom OEM/private-label available.

## Key Facts

- **Entity type**: Manufacturer & wholesale exporter (B2B)
- **Founded**: 1995
- **Location**: Jain Nasiya Road, Near Jain Hostel, Sanganer, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302029, India
- **Contact**: Sezan@ins-overseas.com | WhatsApp: +91 96804 78483
- **Export markets**: USA, UK, EU, Australia, Japan, Canada, UAE, and 35+ more countries
- **Materials**: Handmade paper from recycled cotton rag (no wood pulp)

## Product Lines

- **Handmade Leather Journals**: Full-grain buffalo leather, hand-stitched bindings, deckle-edge cotton rag paper inserts. Sizes: A4, A5, A6, pocket. MOQ __MOQ:leather-journals__ units.
- **Handmade Paper**: Cotton rag sheets made by hand, tree-free. MOQ __MOQ:handmade-paper__ units.
- **Greeting Cards**: Handmade paper greeting cards and envelopes. MOQ __MOQ:greeting-cards__ units.
- **Leather Bags**: Crossbody bags, totes, pouches. Full-grain leather. MOQ __MOQ:leather-bags__ units.
- **Handmade Paper Gift Boxes**: Recycled cotton rag paper, gold foil accents. MOQ __MOQ:handmade-paper-gift-box__ units.
- **Paper Gift Bags**: Recycled cotton, ribbon handles. MOQ __MOQ:handmade-paper-gift-bag__ units.
- **Seed Paper (Plantable)**: Wildflower-embedded sheets, biodegradable. MOQ __MOQ:handmade-seed-paper__ units.
- **Deckle Edge Paper**: 120–300 gsm cotton rag, fountain-pen and watercolour grade. MOQ confirmed in quote.
- **Handblock Print Fabric**: Natural dye, Sanganer motifs, 100% cotton. MOQ confirmed in quote.
